decisions.reason: A product line of several models with substantial development invested, it fits the firm's announced move toward flexible workplace solutions, so dropping it would write off a sizeable investment.
The chair family sits close to the core offer and was presented on its own page in both years, and chair families in premium furniture tend to stay in the range for years.
This niche accessory line had little public commitment, which makes it more expendable, but it still has several models and links to the rug collection, so management would likely persist with it.
The sofa was publicly promoted as a new designer collaboration with EOOS, and that visible commitment plus the design investment favour keeping it.
A single high standing table with modest investment is relatively easy to drop, but it is close to the core range and any weak results can still be blamed on the pandemic's effect on office demand.
Presented as a flagship of the firm's direction, the rug collection carries a strong public commitment, so dropping it would expose the earlier strategic decision as a mistake.
